Chargers, load management and billing from one maker. Sold and installed by 1 partner in Germany.
Two things shape a project in a German apartment building: funding and metering law.

Funding: a federal programme for charging in multi-family buildings, with up to €2,000 per charging point, opened on 15 April 2026. Applications were accepted until 10 November 2026. Check for a follow-up programme and for state and municipal funding.

Billing by the kWh: when several users are billed from the same charging point, German metering and calibration law (Mess- und Eichrecht) applies in addition to MID. Talk to us before you plan billed charging.
Company cars at home: since January 2026 electricity costs are reimbursed by the exact kWh, so a meter is needed.
